<h3 id="gets-a-list-of-recurringquotes-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|A list of recurring_quotes|Inline|
|401|Unauthorized|Authentication error|[AuthenticationError](#schemaauthenticationerror)|
|403|Forbidden|Authorization error|[AuthorizationError](#schemaauthorizationerror)|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Validation error|[ValidationError](#schemavalidationerror)|
|default|Default|Unexpected Error|[Error](#schemaerror)|

<h3 id="gets-a-list-of-recurringquotes-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|data|[[RecurringQuote](#schemarecurringquote)]|false|none|none|
|meta|[Meta](#schemameta)|false|none|none|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|X-MINIMUM-CLIENT-VERSION|number||The API version|
|200|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of requests left for the time window.|
|200|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The total number of requests in a given time window.|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Adds a RecurringQuote

<a id="opIdstoreRecurringQuote"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://invoicing.co/api/v1/recurring_quotes \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'X-API-TOKEN: TOKEN' \
  -H 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest'
```

`POST /api/v1/recurring_quotes`

Adds an RecurringQuote to the system

<h3 id="adds-a-recurringquote-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|X-API-TOKEN|header|string|true|The API token to be used for authentication|
|X-Requested-With|header|string|true|Used to send the XMLHttpRequest header|
|include|query|string|false|Includes child relationships in the response, format is comma separated. Check each model for the list of associated includes|

<h3 id="shows-an-recurringquote-for-editting-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Returns the RecurringQuote object|[RecurringQuote](#schemarecurringquote)|
|401|Unauthorized|Authentication error|[AuthenticationError](#schemaauthenticationerror)|
|403|Forbidden|Authorization error|[AuthorizationError](#schemaauthorizationerror)|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Validation error|[ValidationError](#schemavalidationerror)|
|default|Default|Unexpected Error|[Error](#schemaerror)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|X-MINIMUM-CLIENT-VERSION|number||The API version|
|200|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of requests left for the time window.|
|200|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The total number of requests in a given time window.|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Performs bulk actions on an array of recurring_quotes

<a id="opIdbulkRecurringQuotes"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://invoicing.co/api/v1/recurring_quotes/bulk \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'X-API-TOKEN: TOKEN' \
  -H 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest' \
  -d '[
    0
  ]'
```

`POST /api/v1/recurring_quotes/bulk`

> Body parameter

```json
[
  0
]
```

<h3 id="performs-bulk-actions-on-an-array-of-recurringquotes-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|X-API-TOKEN|header|string|true|The API token to be used for authentication|
|X-Requested-With|header|string|true|Used to send the XMLHttpRequest header|
|index|query|string|false|Replaces the default response index from data to a user specific string<br><br>ie.<br><br>```html<br>  ?index=new_index<br>```<br><br>response is wrapped<br><br>```json<br>  {<br>    'new_index' : [<br>      .....  <br>    ]<br>  }<br>```<br>|
|body|body|[integer]|true|Hashed ids|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The RecurringQuote response|[RecurringQuote](#schemarecurringquote)|

|403|Forbidden|Authorization error|[AuthorizationError](#schemaauthorizationerror)|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Validation error|[ValidationError](#schemavalidationerror)|
|default|Default|Unexpected Error|[Error](#schemaerror)|

### Response Headers

|---|---|---|---|---|

## Performs a custom action on an RecurringQuote

<a id="opIdactionRecurringQuote"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://invoicing.co/api/v1/recurring_quotes/D2J234DFA/clone_to_quote \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'X-API-TOKEN: TOKEN' \
  -H 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest'
```

`GET /api/v1/recurring_quotes/{id}/{action}`

Performs a custom action on an RecurringQuote.

    The current range of actions are as follows
    - clone_to_RecurringQuote
    - clone_to_quote
    - history
    - delivery_note
    - mark_paid
    - download
    - archive
    - delete
    - email

<h3 id="performs-a-custom-action-on-an-recurringquote-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|X-API-TOKEN|header|string|true|The API token to be used for authentication|
|X-Requested-With|header|string|true|Used to send the XMLHttpRequest header|
|include|query|string|false|Includes child relationships in the response, format is comma separated. Check each model for the list of associated includes|
|id|path|string(string)|true|The RecurringQuote Hashed ID|
|action|path|string(string)|true|The action string to be performed|

<h1 id="invoice-ninja-api-reference-refresh">refresh</h1>

Endpoint definitions for refreshing data.


## Refresh data by timestamp

<a id="opIdpostRefresh"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://invoicing.co/api/v1/refresh?updated_at=1676173763' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'X-API-TOKEN: TOKEN' \
  -H 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest'
```

`POST /api/v1/refresh`

Refreshes the dataset.  

This endpoint can be used if you only need to access the most recent data from a certain point in time. For example, if you only want to retrieve The
most recent data from the last time you accessed the system, you would pass the query parameter ?updated_at=1676173763. (unix timestamp)


<h3 id="refresh-data-by-timestamp-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|updated_at|query|number(integer)|true|The unix timestamp from which the refreshed data should be sent from, if no value is passed the system will assume you require all data.|
|X-API-TOKEN|header|string|true|The API token to be used for authentication|
|X-Requested-With|header|string|true|Used to send the XMLHttpRequest header|
|include|query|string|false|Includes child relationships in the response, format is comma separated. Check each model for the list of associated includes|
|include_static|query|string|false|This include will return the full set of static variables used in the application including:<br>  - Currencies<br>  - Countries <br>  - Languages<br>  - Payment Types<br>  - Email Templatees<br>  - Industries<br>|
|clear_cache|query|string|false|Clears cache<br><br>Clears (and rebuilds) the static variable cache.  <br>|

`GET /api/v1/subscriptions`

|include|query|string|false|Includes child relationships in the response, format is comma separated. Check each model for the list of associated includes|
|per_page|query|integer|false|The number of records to return for each request, default is 20|
|page|query|integer|false|The page number to return for this request (when performing pagination), default is 1|
|sort|query|[string]|false|Order the list by choosing a column and direction. Each value uses the form `column\|asc` or `column\|desc`.<br><br>**Single sort** — for example `sort=created_at\|desc`.<br><br>**Multiple sorts** — for example  <br>`sort[]=id\|desc&sort[]=created_at\|asc`.<br><br>Only `subscriptions` table columns are recognized. ## Gets a list of system logs

<a id="opIdgetSystemLogs"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://invoicing.co/api/v1/system_logs \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'X-API-TOKEN: TOKEN' \
  -H 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest'
```

`GET /api/v1/system_logs`

Lists system logs, search and filters allow fine grained lists to be generated.
     *
     *      Query parameters can be added to performed more fine grained filtering of the system logs, these are handled by the SystemLogFilters class which defines the methods available

<h3 id="gets-a-list-of-system-logs-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|X-API-TOKEN|header|string|true|The API token to be used for authentication|
|X-Requested-With|header|string|true|Used to send the XMLHttpRequest header|
|include|query|string|false|Includes child relationships in the response, format is comma separated. Check each model for the list of associated includes|
|per_page|query|integer|false|The number of records to return for each request, default is 20|
|page|query|integer|false|The page number to return for this request (when performing pagination), default is 1|
|sort|query|[string]|false|Order the list by choosing a column and direction. Each value uses the form `column\|asc` or `column\|desc`.<br><br>**Single sort** — for example `sort=created_at\|desc`.<br><br>**Multiple sorts** — for example  <br>`sort[]=id\|desc&sort[]=created_at\|desc`.<br><br>Log rows sort by columns exposed through `SystemLogFilters`. Unsupported keys are ignored.<br>|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "AS3df3A",
      "user_id": "AS3df3A",
      "client_id": "AS3df3A",
      "event_id": 1,
      "category_id": 1,
      "type_id": 1,
      "log": {},
      "updated_at": "2",
      "created_at": "2"
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "pagination": {
      "total": 1,
      "count": 1,
      "per_page": 1,
      "current_page": 1,
      "total_pages": 1,
      "links": {}
    }
  }
}
```

```json
{
  "message": "These credentials do not match our records / Invalid Token"
}
```

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "message": "Insufficient permissions for this resource.",
  "errors": {
    "value": [
      "string"
    ]
  }
}
```

> 422 Response

```json
{
  "message": "The given data was invalid.",
  "errors": {
    "value": [
      "string"
    ]
  }
}
```

> default Response

```json
{
  "message": "Unexpected error",
  "code": 500
}
```

## List tags

`GET /api/v1/tags`

Lists company tags for a single taggable entity type.

|per_page|query|integer|false|The number of records to return for each request, default is 20|
|page|query|integer|false|The page number to return for this request (when performing pagination), default is 1|
|entity_type|query|string|true|Supported values: App\Models\Task, App\Models\Project|
|filter|query|string|false|Search by tag name|
|sort|query|string|false|Sort using column\|direction, for example name\|asc or created_at\|desc|

|entity_type|project|

## Create task scheduler with job

<a id="opIdcreateTaskScheduler"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://invoicing.co/api/v1/task_schedulers \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest' \
  -d '{
    "paused": false,
    "repeat_every": "DAY",
    "start_from": 1652898504,
    "job": "create_credit_report",
    "date_range": "last7",
    "date_key": "created_at",
    "start_date": "2022-10-31",
    "end_date": "2022-10-31",
    "report_keys": [
      "['\''name'\'','\''date'\'']"
    ]
  }'
```

## Gets a list of company tokens

<a id="opIdgetTokens"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://invoicing.co/api/v1/tokens \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'X-API-TOKEN: TOKEN' \
  -H 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest'
```

`GET /api/v1/tokens`

Lists company tokens.
     *
     *   Query parameters can be added to performed more fine grained filtering of the tokens, these are handled by the TokenFilters class which defines the methods available

<h3 id="gets-a-list-of-company-tokens-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|X-API-TOKEN|header|string|true|The API token to be used for authentication|
|X-Requested-With|header|string|true|Used to send the XMLHttpRequest header|
|include|query|string|false|Includes child relationships in the response, format is comma separated. Check each model for the list of associated includes|
|index|query|string|false|Replaces the default response index from data to a user specific string<br><br>ie.<br><br>```html<br>  ?index=new_index<br>```<br><br>response is wrapped<br><br>```json<br>  {<br>    'new_index' : [<br>      .....  <br>    ]<br>  }<br>```<br>|
|per_page|query|integer|false|The number of records to return for each request, default is 20|
|page|query|integer|false|The page number to return for this request (when performing pagination), default is 1|
|sort|query|[string]|false|Order the list by choosing a column and direction. Each value uses the form `column\|asc` or `column\|desc`.<br><br>**Single sort** — for example `sort=name\|asc`.<br><br>**Multiple sorts** — for example  <br>`sort[]=id\|desc&sort[]=name\|asc`.<br><br>Company tokens sort by columns on `company_tokens`. Unsupported keys are ignored.<br>|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "name": "Token Name",
      "token": "AS3df3jUUH765fhfd9KJuidj3JShjA",
      "is_system": true
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "pagination": {
      "total": 1,
      "count": 1,
      "per_page": 1,
      "current_page": 1,
      "total_pages": 1,
      "links": {}
    }
  }
}
```

> 401 Response

```json
{
  "message": "These credentials do not match our records / Invalid Token"
}
```

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "message": "Insufficient permissions for this resource.",
  "errors": {
    "value": [
      "string"
    ]
  }
}
```

> 422 Response

```json
{
  "message": "The given data was invalid.",
  "errors": {
    "value": [
      "string"
    ]
  }
}
```

> default Response

```json
{
  "message": "Unexpected error",
  "code": 500
}
```

## Gets a list of users

<a id="opIdgetUsers"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://invoicing.co/api/v1/users \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'X-API-TOKEN: TOKEN' \
  -H 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest'
```

`GET /api/v1/users`

Lists users, search and filters allow fine grained lists to be generated.

    Query parameters can be added to performed more fine grained filtering of the users, these are handled by the UserFilters class which defines the methods available

<h3 id="gets-a-list-of-users-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|X-API-TOKEN|header|string|true|The API token to be used for authentication|
|X-Requested-With|header|string|true|Used to send the XMLHttpRequest header|
|include|query|string|false|Includes child relationships in the response, format is comma separated. Check each model for the list of associated includes|
|per_page|query|integer|false|The number of records to return for each request, default is 20|
|page|query|integer|false|The page number to return for this request (when performing pagination), default is 1|
|sort|query|[string]|false|Order the list by choosing a column and direction. Each value uses the form `column\|asc` or `column\|desc`.<br><br>**Single sort** — for example `sort=email\|asc`.<br><br>**Multiple sorts** — for example  <br>`sort[]=last_name\|asc&sort[]=first_name\|asc`.<br><br>Only `users` table columns are recognized. Unsupported keys are ignored.<br>|

<h3 id="gets-a-list-of-users-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|A list of users|Inline|
|401|Unauthorized|Authentication error|[AuthenticationError](#schemaauthenticationerror)|
|403|Forbidden|Authorization error|[AuthorizationError](#schemaauthorizationerror)|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Validation error|[ValidationError](#schemavalidationerror)|
|default|Default|Unexpected Error|[Error](#schemaerror)|

<h3 id="gets-a-list-of-users-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|data|[[User](#schemauser)]|false|none|none|
|meta|[Meta](#schemameta)|false|none|none|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|X-MINIMUM-CLIENT-VERSION|number||The API version|
|200|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of requests left for the time window.|
|200|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The total number of requests in a given time window.|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Adds a User

<a id="opIdstoreUser"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://invoicing.co/api/v1/users \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'X-API-TOKEN: TOKEN' \
  -H 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest'
```

`POST /api/v1/users`

Adds an User to the system

<h3 id="adds-a-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|X-API-TOKEN|header|string|true|The API token to be used for authentication|
|X-Requested-With|header|string|true|Used to send the XMLHttpRequest header|
|include|query|string|false|Includes child relationships in the response, format is comma separated. Check each model for the list of associated includes|

## Shows an User

<a id="opIdshowUser"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://invoicing.co/api/v1/users/D2J234DFA \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'X-API-TOKEN: TOKEN' \
  -H 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest'
```

`GET /api/v1/users/{id}`

Displays an User by id

<h3 id="shows-an-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|X-API-TOKEN|header|string|true|The API token to be used for authentication|
|X-Requested-With|header|string|true|Used to send the XMLHttpRequest header|
|include|query|string|false|Includes child relationships in the response, format is comma separated. Check each model for the list of associated includes|
|id|path|string(string)|true|The User Hashed ID|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

<h3 id="shows-an-user-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Returns the User object|[User](#schemauser)|
|401|Unauthorized|Authentication error|[AuthenticationError](#schemaauthenticationerror)|
|403|Forbidden|Authorization error|[AuthorizationError](#schemaauthorizationerror)|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Validation error|[ValidationError](#schemavalidationerror)|
|default|Default|Unexpected Error|[Error](#schemaerror)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|X-MINIMUM-CLIENT-VERSION|number||The API version|
|200|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of requests left for the time window.|
|200|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The total number of requests in a given time window.|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Updates an User

<a id="opIdupdateUser"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://invoicing.co/api/v1/users/D2J234DFA \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'X-API-TOKEN: TOKEN' \
  -H 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest'
```

`PUT /api/v1/users/{id}`

Handles the updating of an User by id

<h3 id="updates-an-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|X-API-TOKEN|header|string|true|The API token to be used for authentication|
|X-Requested-With|header|string|true|Used to send the XMLHttpRequest header|
|include|query|string|false|Includes child relationships in the response, format is comma separated. Check each model for the list of associated includes|
|id|path|string(string)|true|The User Hashed ID|

<h3 id="updates-an-user-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Returns the User object|[User](#schemauser)|
|401|Unauthorized|Authentication error|[AuthenticationError](#schemaauthenticationerror)|
|403|Forbidden|Authorization error|[AuthorizationError](#schemaauthorizationerror)|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Validation error|[ValidationError](#schemavalidationerror)|
|default|Default|Unexpected Error|[Error](#schemaerror)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|X-MINIMUM-CLIENT-VERSION|number||The API version|
|200|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of requests left for the time window.|
|200|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The total number of requests in a given time window.|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Deletes a User

<a id="opIddeleteUser"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://invoicing.co/api/v1/users/D2J234DFA \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'X-API-TOKEN: TOKEN' \
  -H 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest'
```

`DELETE /api/v1/users/{id}`

Handles the deletion of an User by id

<h3 id="deletes-a-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|X-API-TOKEN|header|string|true|The API token to be used for authentication|
|X-Requested-With|header|string|true|Used to send the XMLHttpRequest header|
|include|query|string|false|Includes child relationships in the response, format is comma separated. Check each model for the list of associated includes|
|token_name|query|string(string)|false|Customized name for the Users API Token|
|id|path|string(string)|true|The User Hashed ID|

> Example responses

> 401 Response

```json
{
  "message": "These credentials do not match our records / Invalid Token"
}
```

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "message": "Insufficient permissions for this resource.",
  "errors": {
    "value": [
      "string"
    ]
  }
}
```

> 422 Response

```json
{
  "message": "The given data was invalid.",
  "errors": {
    "value": [
      "string"
    ]
  }
}
```

> default Response

```json
{
  "message": "Unexpected error",
  "code": 500
}
```

<h3 id="deletes-a-user-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Returns a HTTP status|None|
|401|Unauthorized|Authentication error|[AuthenticationError](#schemaauthenticationerror)|
|403|Forbidden|Authorization error|[AuthorizationError](#schemaauthorizationerror)|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Validation error|[ValidationError](#schemavalidationerror)|
|default|Default|Unexpected Error|[Error](#schemaerror)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|X-MINIMUM-CLIENT-VERSION|number||The API version|
|200|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of requests left for the time window.|
|200|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The total number of requests in a given time window.|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Shows an User for editting

<a id="opIdeditUser"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://invoicing.co/api/v1/users/D2J234DFA/edit \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'X-API-TOKEN: TOKEN' \
  -H 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest'
```

`GET /api/v1/users/{id}/edit`

Displays an User by id

<h3 id="shows-an-user-for-editting-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|X-API-TOKEN|header|string|true|The API token to be used for authentication|
|X-Requested-With|header|string|true|Used to send the XMLHttpRequest header|
|include|query|string|false|Includes child relationships in the response, format is comma separated. Check each model for the list of associated includes|
|id|path|string(string)|true|The User Hashed ID|

<h3 id="shows-an-user-for-editting-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Returns the User object|[User](#schemauser)|
|401|Unauthorized|Authentication error|[AuthenticationError](#schemaauthenticationerror)|
|403|Forbidden|Authorization error|[AuthorizationError](#schemaauthorizationerror)|
|422|Unprocessable Entity|Validation error|[ValidationError](#schemavalidationerror)|
|default|Default|Unexpected Error|[Error](#schemaerror)|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|X-MINIMUM-CLIENT-VERSION|number||The API version|
|200|X-RateLimit-Remaining|integer||The number of requests left for the time window.|
|200|X-RateLimit-Limit|integer||The total number of requests in a given time window.|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Performs bulk actions on an array of users

<a id="opIdbulkUsers"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://invoicing.co/api/v1/users/bulk \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'X-API-TOKEN: TOKEN' \
  -H 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest' \
  -d '[
    0
  ]'
```

`POST /api/v1/users/bulk`

> Body parameter

```json
[
  0
]
```

<h3 id="performs-bulk-actions-on-an-array-of-users-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|X-API-TOKEN|header|string|true|The API token to be used for authentication|
|X-Requested-With|header|string|true|Used to send the XMLHttpRequest header|
|index|query|string|false|Replaces the default response index from data to a user specific string<br><br>ie.<br><br>```html<br>  ?index=new_index<br>```<br><br>response is wrapped<br><br>```json<br>  {<br>    'new_index' : [<br>      .....  <br>    ]<br>  }<br>```<br>|
|body|body|[integer]|true|Hashed ids|

## Gets a list of Webhooks

<a id="opIdgetWebhooks"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://invoicing.co/api/v1/webhooks \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'X-API-TOKEN: TOKEN' \
  -H 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest'
```

`GET /api/v1/webhooks`

Lists Webhooks, search and filters allow fine grained lists to be generated.
     *
     *      Query parameters can be added to performed more fine grained filtering of the Webhooks, these are handled by the WebhookFilters class which defines the methods available

<h3 id="gets-a-list-of-webhooks-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|X-API-TOKEN|header|string|true|The API token to be used for authentication|
|X-Requested-With|header|string|true|Used to send the XMLHttpRequest header|
|include|query|string|false|Includes child relationships in the response, format is comma separated. Check each model for the list of associated includes|
|index|query|string|false|Replaces the default response index from data to a user specific string<br><br>ie.<br><br>```html<br>  ?index=new_index<br>```<br><br>response is wrapped<br><br>```json<br>  {<br>    'new_index' : [<br>      .....  <br>    ]<br>  }<br>```<br>|
|per_page|query|integer|false|The number of records to return for each request, default is 20|
|page|query|integer|false|The page number to return for this request (when performing pagination), default is 1|
|sort|query|[string]|false|Order the list by choosing a column and direction. Each value uses the form `column\|asc` or `column\|desc`.<br><br>**Single sort** — for example `sort=created_at\|desc`.<br><br>**Multiple sorts** — for example  <br>`sort[]=id\|desc&sort[]=created_at\|asc`.<br><br>Only `webhooks` table columns apply. Unsupported keys are ignored.<br>|

This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|quantity|number|false|none|The quantity of the product offered for this line item|
|cost|number(float)|false|none|The cost of the product offered for this line item|
|product_key|string|false|none|The product key of the product offered for this line item (Referred to as Product in the product tab)|
|tags|string|false|none|A comma-separated snapshot of the product tag names for this line item|
|product_cost|number(float)|false|none|The cost of the product offered for this line item (Referred to as Cost in the product tab)|
|notes|string|false|none|The notes/description for the product offered for this line item|
|discount|number(float)|false|none|The discount applied to the product offered for this line item|
|is_amount_discount|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether the discount applied to the product offered for this line item is a fixed amount or a percentage|
|tax_name1|string|false|none|The name of the first tax applied to the product offered for this line item|
|tax_rate1|number(float)|false|none|The rate of the first tax applied to the product offered for this line item|
|tax_name2|string|false|none|The name of the second tax applied to the product offered for this line item|
|tax_rate2|number(float)|false|none|The rate of the second tax applied to the product offered for this line item|
|tax_name3|string|false|none|The name of the third tax applied to the product offered for this line item|
|tax_rate3|number(float)|false|none|The rate of the third tax applied to the product offered for this line item|
|sort_id|string|false|none|**Deprecated.** Deprecated|
|line_total|number(float)|false|read-only|The total amount of the product offered for this line item|
|gross_line_total|number(float)|false|read-only|The total amount of the product offered for this line item before discounts|
|tax_amount|number(float)|false|read-only|The total amount of tax applied to the product offered for this line item|
|custom_value1|string|false|none|The first custom value of the product offered for this line item|
|custom_value2|string|false|none|The second custom value of the product offered for this line item|
|custom_value3|string|false|none|The third custom value of the product offered for this line item|
|custom_value4|string|false|none|The fourth custom value of the product offered for this line item|
|type_id|string|false|none|1 = product, 2 = service, 3 unpaid gateway fee, 4 paid gateway fee, 5 late fee, 6 expense|
|tax_id|string|false|none|The tax ID of the product: 1 product, 2 service, 3 digital, 4 shipping, 5 exempt, 5 reduced tax, 7 override, 8 zero rate, 9 reverse tax|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|false|read-only|The unique identifier of the client|
|contacts|[[ClientContact](#schemaclientcontact)]|false|none|none|
|user_id|string|false|read-only|The unique identifier of the user who created the client|
|assigned_user_id|string|false|none|The unique identifier of the user who has been assigned the client|
|name|string|false|none|The name of the client company or organization|
|website|string|false|none|The website URL of the client company or organization|
|private_notes|string|false|none|Notes that are only visible to the user who created the client|
|client_hash|string|false|read-only|A unique hash value for the client|
|industry_id|number|false|none|The unique identifier of the industry the client operates in|
|size_id|number|false|none|The unique identifier for the size category of the client company or organization|
|address1|string|false|none|First line of the client's address|
|address2|string|false|none|Second line of the client's address, if needed|
|city|string|false|none|The city the client is located in|
|state|string|false|none|The state, province, or locality the client is located in|
|postal_code|string|false|none|The postal code or ZIP code of the client|
|phone|string|false|none|The client's phone number|
|country_id|[CountryType](#schemacountrytype)|false|none|The unique identifier of the client's country|
|custom_value1|string|false|none|A custom field for storing additional information|
|custom_value2|string|false|none|A custom field for storing additional information|
|custom_value3|string|false|none|A custom field for storing additional information|
|custom_value4|string|false|none|A custom field for storing additional information|
|vat_number|string|false|none|The client's VAT (Value Added Tax) number, if applicable|
|id_number|string|false|none|A unique identification number for the client, such as a tax ID or business registration number|
|number|string|false|none|A system-assigned unique number for the client, typically used for invoicing purposes|
|shipping_address1|string|false|none|First line of the client's shipping address|
|shipping_address2|string|false|none|Second line of the client's shipping address, if needed|
|shipping_city|string|false|none|The city of the client's shipping address|
|shipping_state|string|false|none|The state, province, or locality of the client's shipping address|
|shipping_postal_code|string|false|none|The postal code or ZIP code of the client's shipping address|
|shipping_country_id|number(integer)|false|none|The unique identifier of the country for the client's shipping address|
|is_deleted|boolean|false|read-only|A boolean value indicating whether the client has been deleted or not|
|balance|number(float)|false|read-only|The outstanding balance the client owes|
|paid_to_date|number(float)|false|read-only|The total amount the client has paid to date|
|credit_balance|number(float)|false|read-only|The available credit balance for the client to use on future purchases|
|last_login|number(integer)|false|read-only|The timestamp of the client's last login|
|created_at|number(integer)|false|read-only|The timestamp when the client was created|
|updated_at|number(integer)|false|read-only|The timestamp when the client was last updated|
|group_settings_id|string|false|none|The group settings assigned to the client|
|routing_id|string|false|none|The routing address id for e-invoicing for this client|
|is_tax_exempt|boolean|false|none|Flag which defines if the client is exempt from taxes|
|has_valid_vat_number|boolean|false|read-only|Flag which defines if the client has a valid VAT number|
|payment_balance|number|false|read-only|Defines the payment balance the client has on file (pre payments / over payments / unapplied amounts)|
|settings|[ClientSettings](#schemaclientsettings)|false|none|none|
|classification|string|false|none|Classification or category label for organizational purposes|
|public_notes|string|false|none|Notes that are visible to the client|

|tax_name3|string|false|none|The name of the third tax applied to the purchase order|

|amount|number(float)|false|none|The total amount of the purchase order before taxes and discounts|
|balance|number(float)|false|none|The balance due for the purchase order after accounting for payments|
|paid_to_date|number(float)|false|none|The total amount paid on the purchase order so far|
|discount|number(float)|false|none|The discount amount or percentage applied to the purchase order|
|partial|number(float)|false|none|The partial or deposit amount for the purchase order|
|is_amount_discount|boolean|false|none|Boolean flag indicating if the discount is a fixed amount or a percentage|
|is_deleted|boolean|false|none|Boolean flag indicating if the purchase order has been deleted|
|uses_inclusive_taxes|boolean|false|none|Boolean flag indicating if the taxes used are inclusive or exclusive|
|date|string(date)|false|none|The date the purchase order was created|
|last_sent_date|string(date)|false|none|The last date the purchase order was sent to the vendor|
|next_send_date|string(date)|false|none|The next scheduled date for sending a reminder for the purchase order|
|partial_due_date|string(date)|false|none|The due date for the partial or deposit amount|

|updated_at|number(integer)|false|none|Timestamp|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|false|read-only|The unique hashed identifier for the company|
|size_id|string|false|none|The unique identifier representing the company's size category|
|industry_id|string|false|none|The unique identifier representing the company's industry category|
|slack_webhook_url|string|false|none|The URL for the company's Slack webhook notifications|
|google_analytics_key|string|false|none|The company's Google Analytics tracking ID|
|portal_mode|string|false|none|The mode determining how client-facing URLs are structured (e.g., subdomain, domain, or iframe)|
|subdomain|string|false|none|The subdomain prefix for the company's domain (e.g., 'acme' in acme.domain.com)|
|portal_domain|string|false|none|The fully qualified domain used for client-facing URLs|
|enabled_tax_rates|integer|false|none|The number of tax rates used per entity|
|fill_products|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to auto-fill product descriptions based on the product key|
|convert_products|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to convert products between different types or units|
|update_products|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to update product descriptions when the description changes|
|show_product_details|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to display product details in the user interface|
|show_product_cost|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to display product cost is shown in the user interface|
|custom_fields|object|false|none|A mapping of custom fields for various objects within the company<br><br>**note** <br>The custom fields object is formatted as follows<br><br>  key : value<br>  entity(integer) : label\|type<br><br>  for example:<br>  "company1": "Number\|single_line_text",<br><br>  This defines the first company custom field, with label Number which has a custom field type of a single text line<br><br>  Supported entity types<br><br>  invoice<br>  product<br>  client<br>  contact<br>  task<br>  user<br>  project<br>  vendor <br>  expense<br>  payment     <br><br>  Supported input types values<br><br>  single_line_text<br>  date<br>  switch<br><br>  For text areas, you only need to supply the label ie "TextArea", the \| and type values are not required.<br>  For the dropdown the data format is as follows:<br><br>  label\|your,drop,down,values,in,comma,separated,format<br>|
|enable_product_cost|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to show or hide the product cost field in the user interface|
|enable_product_quantity|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to show or hide the product quantity field in the user interface|
|default_quantity|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to use a default quantity for products|
|custom_surcharge_taxes1|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to apply taxes on custom surcharge amounts for the first custom surcharge field|
|custom_surcharge_taxes2|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to apply taxes on custom surcharge amounts for the second custom surcharge field|
|custom_surcharge_taxes3|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to apply taxes on custom surcharge amounts for the third custom surcharge field|
|custom_surcharge_taxes4|object|false|none|A flag determining whether to apply taxes on custom surcharge amounts for the fourth custom|
|logo|string(binary)|false|none|The company logo file in binary format|
|company_key|string|false|read-only|The static company key hash used to identify the Company|
|client_can_register|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether clients can register for the client portal|
|enabled_modules|integer|false|none|Bitmask representation of the modules that are enabled in the application<br><br>```<br>self::ENTITY_RECURRING_INVOICE => 1,<br>self::ENTITY_CREDIT => 2,<br>self::ENTITY_QUOTE => 4,<br>self::ENTITY_TASK => 8,<br>self::ENTITY_EXPENSE => 16,<br>self::ENTITY_PROJECT => 32,<br>self::ENTITY_VENDOR => 64,<br>self::ENTITY_TICKET => 128,<br>self::ENTITY_PROPOSAL => 256,<br>self::ENTITY_RECURRING_EXPENSE => 512,<br>self::ENTITY_RECURRING_TASK => 1024,<br>self::ENTITY_RECURRING_QUOTE => 2048,<br>```<br><br>The default per_page value is 20.<br>|
|db|string|false|read-only|none|
|first_day_of_week|string|false|none|The first day of the week for the company|
|first_month_of_year|string|false|none|The first month for the company financial year|
|enabled_item_tax_rates|integer|false|none|The number of tax rates used per item|
|is_large|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether the company is considered large|
|default_auto_bill|string|false|none|A flag determining whether to auto-bill clients by default<br><br>values:<br><br>- always - Always auto bill<br>- disabled - Never auto bill<br>- optin - Allow the client to select their auto bill status with the default being disabled<br>- optout -Allow the client to select their auto bill status with the default being enabled<br>|
|mark_expenses_invoiceable|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to mark expenses as invoiceable by default|
|mark_expenses_paid|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to mark expenses as paid by default|
|invoice_expense_documents|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to include expense documents on invoices by default|
|auto_start_tasks|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to auto-start tasks by default|
|invoice_task_timelog|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to include task time logs on invoices by default|
|invoice_task_documents|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to include task documents on invoices by default|
|show_tasks_table|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to show the tasks table on invoices by default|
|is_disabled|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether the company is disabled|
|default_task_is_date_based|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to default tasks to be date-based|
|enable_product_discount|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to show or hide the product discount field in the user interface|
|calculate_expense_tax_by_amount|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to calculate expense taxes by amount|
|expense_inclusive_taxes|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to include taxes in the expense amount|
|session_timeout|integer|false|none|The session timeout for the company|
|oauth_password_required|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to require a password for `dangerous` actions when using OAuth|
|invoice_task_datelog|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to include task date logs on invoices by default|
|default_password_timeout|integer|false|none|The default password timeout for the company|
|show_task_end_date|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to show the task end date on invoices by default|
|markdown_enabled|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether markdown is enabled for the company|
|report_include_drafts|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to include draft invoices in reports|
|client_registration_fields|object|false|none|The client registration fields for the company|
|stop_on_unpaid_recurring|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to stop recurring invoices when they are unpaid|
|use_quote_terms_on_conversion|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to use quote terms on conversion to an invoice|
|enable_applying_payments|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to enable applying payments to invoices|
|track_inventory|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to track inventory for the company|
|inventory_notification_threshold|integer|false|none|The inventory notification threshold for the company|
|stock_notification|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to send stock notifications for the company|
|matomo_url|string|false|none|The Matomo URL for the company|
|matomo_id|string|false|none|The Matomo ID for the company|
|enabled_expense_tax_rates|integer|false|none|The number of tax rates used per expense|
|invoice_task_project|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to include the project on invoices by default|
|report_include_deleted|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to include deleted invoices in reports|
|invoice_task_lock|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to lock tasks when invoiced|
|convert_payment_currency|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to convert the payment currency|
|convert_expense_currency|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to convert the expense currency|
|notify_vendor_when_paid|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to notify the vendor when an expense is paid|
|invoice_task_hours|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to include the task hours on invoices by default|
|calculate_taxes|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to calculate taxes for the company|
|tax_data|object|false|none|The tax data for the company|
|e_invoice_certificate|string|false|none|The e-invoice certificate for the company|
|e_invoice_certificate_passphrase|string|false|none|The e-invoice certificate passphrase for the company|
|origin_tax_data|object|false|none|The origin tax data for the company|
|invoice_task_project_header|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to include the project header on invoices by default|
|invoice_task_item_description|boolean|false|none|A flag determining whether to include the item description on invoices by default|
|expense_mailbox|string|false|none|The email address for the expense mailbox|
|expense_mailbox_active|boolean|false|none|Whether the expense mailbox is active|
|inbound_mailbox_allow_company_users|boolean|false|none|Whether company users are allowed to use the inbound mailbox|
|inbound_mailbox_allow_vendors|boolean|false|none|Whether vendors are allowed to use the inbound mailbox|
|inbound_mailbox_allow_clients|boolean|false|none|Whether clients are allowed to use the inbound mailbox|
|inbound_mailbox_allow_unknown|boolean|false|none|Whether unknown senders are allowed to use the inbound mailbox|
|inbound_mailbox_whitelist|string|false|none|Comma-separated list of whitelisted email addresses for the inbound mailbox|
|inbound_mailbox_blacklist|string|false|none|Comma-separated list of blacklisted email addresses for the inbound mailbox|
|smtp_host|string|false|none|The SMTP host for sending emails|
|smtp_port|integer|false|none|The SMTP port for sending emails|
|smtp_encryption|string \| null|false|none|The encryption method for SMTP|
|smtp_local_domain|string|false|none|The local domain for SMTP|
|smtp_verify_peer|boolean|false|none|Whether to verify the SMTP peer|
|e_invoice|object|false|none|E-invoice settings for the company|
|legal_entity_id|integer|false|none|The ID of the legal entity associated with the company|
|convert_rate_to_client|boolean|false|none|Flag indicating whether to convert rates to the client currency|
|e_invoicing_token|string|false|none|Authentication token for e-invoicing services|
|enable_shop_api|boolean|false|none|Flag indicating whether the shop API is enabled|
|markdown_email_enabled|boolean|false|none|Flag indicating whether markdown formatting is enabled in emails|
|use_comma_as_decimal_place|boolean|false|none|Flag indicating whether to use comma as decimal separator instead of period|

|client_id|string|false|none|The unique hashed ID of the client associated with the credit|
|status_id|string|false|none|The ID representing the current status of the credit|
|invoice_id|string|false|none|The unique hashed ID of the linked invoice to which the credit is applied|
|number|string|false|none|The unique alphanumeric credit number per company|
|po_number|string|false|none|The purchase order number referred to by the credit|
|terms|string|false|none|The terms associated with the credit|
|public_notes|string|false|none|Public notes for the credit|
|private_notes|string|false|none|Private notes for internal use, not visible to the client|
|footer|string|false|none|The footer text for the credit|
|custom_value1|string|false|none|Custom value 1 for additional credit information|
|custom_value2|string|false|none|Custom value 2 for additional credit information|
|custom_value3|string|false|none|Custom value 3 for additional credit information|
|custom_value4|string|false|none|Custom value 4 for additional credit information|
|tax_name1|string|false|none|The name of the first tax applied to the credit|
|tax_name2|string|false|none|The name of the second tax applied to the credit|
|tax_rate1|number(float)|false|none|The rate of the first tax applied to the credit|
|tax_rate2|number(float)|false|none|The rate of the second tax applied to the credit|
|tax_name3|string|false|none|The name of the third tax applied to the credit|
|tax_rate3|number(float)|false|none|The rate of the third tax applied to the credit|
|total_taxes|number(float)|false|none|The total amount of taxes for the credit|

|invitations|[[CreditInvitation](#schemacreditinvitation)]|false|none|An array of objects which define the invitations of the credit|
|amount|number(float)|false|none|The total amount of the credit|
|balance|number(float)|false|none|The outstanding balance of the credit|
|paid_to_date|number(float)|false|none|The total amount paid to date for the credit|
|discount|number(float)|false|none|The discount applied to the credit|
|partial|number(float)|false|none|The partial amount applied to the credit|
|is_amount_discount|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether the discount applied is a fixed amount or a percentage|
|is_deleted|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether the credit has been deleted|
|uses_inclusive_taxes|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether the tax rates applied to the credit are inclusive or exclusive|
|date|string(date)|false|none|The date the credit was issued|
|last_sent_date|string(date)|false|none|The date the credit was last sent out|

|private_notes|string|false|none|Notes that are only visible to the user who created the client|
|industry_id|number|false|none|The unique identifier of the industry the client operates in|
|size_id|number|false|none|The unique identifier for the size category of the client company or organization|
|address1|string|false|none|First line of the client's address|
|address2|string|false|none|Second line of the client's address, if needed|
|city|string|false|none|The city the client is located in|
|state|string|false|none|The state, province, or locality the client is located in|
|postal_code|string|false|none|The postal code or ZIP code of the client|
|phone|string|false|none|The client's phone number|
|country_id|[CountryType](#schemacountrytype)|true|none|The unique identifier of the client's country expressed by the countries ISO number.<br><br>Optionally, instead of the country_id you can pass either the iso_3166_2 or iso_3166_3 country code into the country_code property.<br>|
|custom_value1|string|false|none|A custom field for storing additional information|
|custom_value2|string|false|none|A custom field for storing additional information|
|custom_value3|string|false|none|A custom field for storing additional information|

|id_number|string|false|none|A unique identification number for the client, such as a tax ID or business registration number|

|shipping_address1|string|false|none|First line of the client's shipping address|
|shipping_address2|string|false|none|Second line of the client's shipping address, if needed|
|shipping_city|string|false|none|The city of the client's shipping address|
|shipping_state|string|false|none|The state, province, or locality of the client's shipping address|
|shipping_postal_code|string|false|none|The postal code or ZIP code of the client's shipping address|
|shipping_country_id|number(integer)|false|none|The unique identifier of the client's shipping country expressed by the countries ISO number.<br><br>Optionally, instead of the shipping_country_id you can pass either the iso_3166_2 or iso_3166_3 country code into the shipping_country_code property.<br>|
|is_deleted|boolean|false|read-only|A boolean value indicating whether the client has been deleted or not|
|group_settings_id|string|false|none|The group settings assigned to the client|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|permissions|string|false|none|The user permissions for this company in a comma separated list|
|settings|object|false|read-only|Settings that are used for the flutter applications to store user preferences / metadata|
|react_settings|object|false|read-only|Dedicated settings object for the react web application|
|is_owner|boolean|false|read-only|Determines whether the user owns this company|
|is_admin|boolean|false|read-only|Determines whether the user is the admin of this company|
|is_locked|boolean|false|read-only|Determines whether the users access to this company has been locked|
|updated_at|integer|false|none|The last time the record was modified, format Unix Timestamp|
|deleted_at|integer|false|none|Timestamp when the user was archived, format Unix Timestamp|
|account|[Account](#schemaaccount)|false|none|none|
|company|[Company](#schemacompany)|false|none|none|
|user|[UserRef](#schemauserref)|false|none|none|
|token|[CompanyToken](#schemacompanytoken)|false|none|none|
